tiles.title: Top alerts with MITRE tactics and product
Risk trend: this week vs previous week
Mean time to close by severity (hours)
Users at risk by risk level
Identity & app changes (MFA, consent, service principals, apps)
Data volume by source (events in range)
Detection coverage by domain (alerts per product)

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let Inc = external_table('SecurityIncident')
| where CreatedTime between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by IncidentNumber
| extend Cls = iff(isempty(Classification), "Unclassified", Classification),
         MTTCh = iff(Status == "Closed" and isnotempty(ClosedTime), datetime_diff('minute', ClosedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0, real(null)),
         MTTAh = iff(isnotempty(FirstModifiedTime) and FirstModifiedTime > CreatedTime, datetime_diff('minute', FirstModifiedTime, CreatedTime) / 60.0, real(null)),
         OwnerName = tostring(coalesce(Owner.assignedTo, Owner.email, "Unassigned")),
         Tactics = tostring(AdditionalData.tactics), Products = tostring(AdditionalData.alertProductNames),
         AlertsCount = toint(AdditionalData.alertsCount);
Inc | summarize ClosureRate = round(100.0 * countif(Status == "Closed") / count(), 1)

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
external_table('AuditLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where OperationName has_any ("Add member to role", "Add eligible member to role", "Add owner to", "Add app role assignment")
| extend Target = tostring(TargetResources[0].userPrincipalName), Role = tostring(TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties[1].newValue), Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Target, Role, Actor, Result
| order by TimeGenerated desc | take 50

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
let SI = external_table('SigninLogs')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, ResultType, IPAddress, Location, AppDisplayName,
          Risk = tostring(column_ifexists('RiskLevelDuringSignIn', '')),
          CA = tostring(column_ifexists('ConditionalAccessStatus', '')),
          AuthReq = tostring(column_ifexists('AuthenticationRequirement', ''));
SI | where isnotempty(IPAddress)
| summarize SignIns = count(), Failures = countif(ResultType != "0") by IPAddress, Location
| top 300 by SignIns
| extend g = geo_info_from_ip_address(IPAddress)
| extend Latitude = toreal(g.latitude), Longitude = toreal(g.longitude)
| where isnotnull(Latitude)
| summarize SignIns = sum(SignIns), Failures = sum(Failures) by Location, Latitude = round(Latitude, 1), Longitude = round(Longitude, 1)

| order by Events desc

| summarize Anomalies = count(), MaxPriority = max(InvestigationPriority), Activities = make_set(ActivityType, 5) by UserPrincipalName
| top 20 by MaxPriority

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | summarize Events = count() | extend Source = "SigninLogs"),
 (external_table('AuditLogs') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | summarize Events = count() | extend Source = "AuditLogs"),
 (external_table('SecurityAlert') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | summarize Events = count() | extend Source = "SecurityAlert"),
 (external_table('SecurityIncident') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | summarize Events = count() | extend Source = "SecurityIncident"),
 (external_table('CloudAppEvents') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | summarize Events = count() | extend Source = "CloudAppEvents"),
 (external_table('EmailEvents') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | summarize Events = count() | extend Source = "EmailEvents"),
 (external_table('DeviceProcessEvents') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | summarize Events = count() | extend Source = "DeviceProcessEvents"),
 (external_table('BehaviorAnalytics') | where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime) | summarize Events = count() | extend Source = "BehaviorAnalytics")
| project Source, Events | order by Events desc

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
union
 (external_table('SigninLogs') | summarize Last = max(TimeGenerated) | extend Source = "SigninLogs"),
 (external_table('AuditLogs') | summarize Last = max(TimeGenerated) | extend Source = "AuditLogs"),
 (external_table('SecurityAlert') | summarize Last = max(TimeGenerated) | extend Source = "SecurityAlert"),
 (external_table('SecurityIncident') | summarize Last = max(TimeGenerated) | extend Source = "SecurityIncident"),
 (external_table('CloudAppEvents') | summarize Last = max(TimeGenerated) | extend Source = "CloudAppEvents"),
 (external_table('EmailEvents') | summarize Last = max(TimeGenerated) | extend Source = "EmailEvents"),
 (external_table('DeviceProcessEvents') | summarize Last = max(TimeGenerated) | extend Source = "DeviceProcessEvents")
| extend MinutesSinceLast = datetime_diff('minute', now(), Last),
         Health = case(datetime_diff('minute', now(), Last) <= 60, "Healthy", datetime_diff('minute', now(), Last) <= 1440, "Delayed", "Stale")
| project Source, Last, MinutesSinceLast, Health | order by MinutesSinceLast desc

set query_results_cache_max_age = time(5m);
external_table('AlertInfo')
| where TimeGenerated between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| extend Tech = todynamic(tostring(pack_all().AttackTechniques))
| mv-expand Technique = Tech to typeof(string)
| where isnotempty(Technique)
| summarize Alerts = dcount(AlertId), Sources = make_set(ServiceSource, 5) by Technique
| top 20 by Alerts
